_real_world.class: EA-18G Growler offensive electronic-attack suite: AN/ALQ-218 receiver + AN/ALQ-99 Tactical Jamming System pods (transitioning to AN/ALQ-249 Next Generation Jammer-Mid Band)
_real_world.variant_scope: EA-18G Growler airborne electronic attack loadout, external wing/centerline jamming pods plus internal ALQ-218 receiver, replacing the retired EA-6B Prowler in the CVW
public_equipment: AN/ALQ-99 TJS: 64 MHz - 20 GHz across 10 bands (Wikipedia, NAVAIR)
AN/ALQ-249 NGJ-MB, mid-band successor pod, in fielding alongside ALQ-99 (TWZ, NAVAIR)

_provenance.modeling_note: EA-18G's own offensive stand-off/escort jamming suite, distinct from the Super Hornet self-protection suite (CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67, also fitted internally to the EA-18G). This record represents the externally-carried ALQ-99/NGJ-MB jamming pods plus the ALQ-218 wide-band receiver. No public power_watts, precise per-band bandwidth, or jamming effective_angle figures exist (classified). jammer.bandwidth_mhz reuses the same 64 MHz-20 GHz-derived span as the ALR-67/ALQ-214 record for consistency, since ALQ-99's own sourced frequency range (Wikipedia's Band 1-10 table, 64 MHz to 20 GHz) covers effectively the same span; jammer.power_watts and effective_angle are proxy, scaled modestly above the internal self-protection jammer (CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67) to reflect ALQ-99/NGJ-MB's higher-power stand-off/escort-jamming role versus a self-protection-only system, not a quantified public figure. jammer.type is set to NoiseBarrage since ALQ-99 is publicly described as a noise-jamming tactical jamming system (vs ALQ-214's deception/repeater design), the clearest sourced qualitative distinction available.

rwr.sensitivity_dbm.note: engineering_estimate marginally better than CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67's -90.0, reflecting the EA-18G's dedicated ALQ-218 wide-band receiver role; not a quantified public figure

jammer.power_watts.note: engineering_estimate above CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67's 1000.0, reflecting ALQ-99/NGJ-MB's stand-off/escort jamming role vs a self-protection-only jammer; no public power figure (classified)

jammer.bandwidth_mhz.note: AN/ALQ-99's own published frequency range is 64 MHz to 20 GHz across 10 jamming bands (Wikipedia, cross-confirmed by NAVAIR's product page describing the system generally); span expressed in MHz as (20000-64)~=19936

jammer.type.note: ALQ-99 is publicly described as a noise/barrage tactical jamming system (vs ALQ-214's deception/repeater design); mapped to the NoiseBarrage enum value as the closest qualitative match

jammer.effective_angle.note: engineering_estimate above CSG_US_ALQ-214_ALR-67's 60.0, reflecting wing-pod-mounted stand-off jamming's wider coverage intent vs an internal self-protection jammer; no public figure

jammer.is_active.note: false: default-off state, activated at runtime by mission logic
